summary: Ordinary authored titles may be shortened only in the second provider response with protected text and structural boundaries preserved.
invariants: At most two author provider calls; no local title truncation or larger capacity limits.
Only ordinary non-source dynamic title text is eligible; fixed/source/header chrome and non-target text remain unchanged.
QID role CSS geometry font and structure remain unchanged; preserve checkable numbers named tokens negations and qualifiers.
Failure diagnostics persist only bounded content-free owner counts and SHA256 digests; semantic equivalence is not mechanically guaranteed.
forbidden: Logging rejected HTML text raw QIDs or credentials
